description: The web guard in the TV layout (all settings locked, a Kid stuck in the TV layout): viewer with the probe's Kid role in the TV layout (localStorage 'layout' = 'tv', html.layout-tv). The header's user button opens the Settings menu, where Sign out is shown and the D-pad never lands on a hidden link; a typed locked URL ends on Home; the Display page stays reachable with its layout selector enabled (Kid doesn't lock Display (this device)), so the layout can be switched back. Reads only.

steps.name: the guard has viewer's /Me in the TV layout
the header's user button is shown
it opens the Settings menu
steps.script: document.querySelector('.headerUserButton').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); return location.hash;

steps.name: the Settings menu with Sign out
the D-pad down the page: the focus never on a hidden link, and it reaches Sign out
steps.script: const seen = []; for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) { const t = document.activeElement || document.body; t.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowDown', code: 'ArrowDown', keyCode: 40, which: 40, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const a = document.activeElement; seen.push({ text: a ? (a.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 30) : null, logout: !!a && a.classList.contains('btnLogout'), hidden: a ? getComputedStyle(a).display === 'none' || a.getClientRects().length === 0 : null }); } return seen;

steps.name: no hidden link had the focus; Sign out did
steps.assert: __vars.dpad.every((s) => s.hidden !== true) && __vars.dpad.some((s) => s.logout) && new Set(__vars.dpad.map((s) => s.text)).size > 1

steps.name: a typed locked URL
steps.script: location.hash = '#/mypreferenceshome'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return location.hash;

steps.name: Display is shown with its layout selector
the layout selector enabled (the way out of the TV layout), Display (account) disabled
steps.assert: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#displayPreferencesPage:not(.hide)'); return p.querySelector('.selectLayout').disabled === false && p.querySelector('.chkDisplayMissingEpisodes').disabled === true; })()

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
